# `pi_encrypt`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Install or verify an activation licence (legacy password/licence pair or the plus digest form).

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / probable (64-bit build; 32-bit build probable) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xce370, manualEncrypt @0x3209e0, verifyPlus @0x31d980 (64-bit build); app 3.3.2 BleUtilsV2.requestActive and connectBle, SeestarActivationBody, SignResBean, NetUtils.getEncryptSn, ZApiServiceSeeStar.activateDevice |

Params are a required object or a one-element array holding it. If the legacy pair passwd and license are both nonempty, the legacy path writes the serial, password and licence files and then runs hardware verification. Otherwise a nonempty digest is required and the plus form is parsed and verified. On success the power LED activated state is set. Result is integer 0. Not a read-only check; pi_is_verified is the read-only counterpart. The legacy path returns 210 on devices with an eMMC (branch). Verification, read and write helper errors propagate their own code. Plus-form values are issued by the vendor's activation web service (POST /v1/activation with RSA-encrypted sn/cpuId, model, subModel and location); the app copies the returned sn, cpuId, authCode (as auth_code), digest and sign into a one-element array with id 14 over the BLE route (READ, app 3.3.2). The device checks that sn or cpuId matches the hardware identity (222), that the RSA public-key recovery of the Base64 sign equals auth_code (222), and that digest (Base64 of an HMAC-SHA256 of a device-side string; which string is unresolved) matches (222); a shell failure in these checks gives 214. The app never sends the legacy pair; its issuer (INFERRED a vendor or factory tool) and byte formats are unresolved.

Side effects: Writes licence/activation data files and changes the power LED activation state on success. No handler timeout.

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 107 | Params absent, null, empty array or not an object | `expected object param` |
| 102 | No nonempty legacy pair and no digest | `invalid params` |
| 217 | Plus form: identity, auth_code, digest or sign missing or empty | `string is empty` |
| 210 | Legacy path on a device model with eMMC storage | `not supported` |
| 222 | Old-licence verification mismatch in the hardware verification step; plus form sn/cpuId, auth_code or digest compare mismatch | `fail to verify SN` |
| 214 | Plus form: a shell step of the signature or digest check fails | `fail to run command` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

Other read and write helper codes propagate unchanged and are not enumerated (unresolved).

## Example

Request, plus-form - Plus form in the array shape (values invented):

```json
{"id":91,"method":"pi_encrypt","params":[{"sn":"EXAMPLE-SN","auth_code":"example-auth","digest":"example-digest","sign":"example-sign"}]}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"pi_encrypt","result":0,"code":0,"id":91}
```

Reply, empty-field:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"pi_encrypt","error":"string is empty","code":217,"id":92}
```
